meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把一份文档变成一套带有可爱插画的幻灯片 PDF，并生成一个手机竖屏分享链接；内容太少时会先把文档扩写成较长叙述再做幻灯片。只接受单份文档，只产出幻灯片（不做视频/播客）。
howto.when: 当用户说出“Wowerpoint <文件>”“Make a slide deck about <文件>”等指令，或要求把一份文档做成幻灯片时触发。

howto.what_en: Turns a single document into a kawaii-style slide-deck PDF and returns a mobile share link; if the source is too thin, it first rewrites it as a longer narrative. One document only, slides only (no video/podcast).
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for "Wowerpoint <file>", "make a slide deck about <file>", or similar slide-deck requests.

say_en.note: Produces a PDF and a mobile share link
